title: 情報ネットワーク
subtitle: Information Networks
educationalGoal: Firstly, the students will learn the fact that the network connection is based on the internal hierarchical protocols. Then, each layer of the hierarchy will be focused on stepwise. For example, the hardware, media and wireless technology is addressed in the study of the bottom layer. Especially, the concept of TCP/IP and the structure of IP address, which belong to the intermediate layers and are rather familiar to the end-user with web access, will be illustrated in detail.
advice: This course aims to foster student’s knowledge of network structure and fundamental communication procedure. It is important to understand the contents of this course because many kinds of web service, which becomes mainstream of the computer application today, are realized on the basis of the network technology. The abstract of this course is following: 1. Introduction to Computer Network Subjects: Constituent Element of Network, Communication Method and Protocol Hierarchy, etc. 2. Hierarchy of Protocol Subjects: Application / Transport / Internet / Network Access Layer, etc. 3. Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) Subjects: Basic structure of LAN, Internetworking, etc. 4. Actual Operation of Network Subjects: Method of troubleshooting using network diagnostic commands, Security, etc. Although this course mainly adopts classroom lecture, sometimes the learners are required to practice some commands related to network maintenance.
books: Textbook: Surasura Wakaru Network & TCP/IP no kihon (SBI Creative)
requiredKnowledge: It is preferable for the students to have acquired a credit of the course“Introduction to Server Management” . At the 1st class, the supervisor will give an instruction of the usage of Learning Management System (LMS), which supports the learning of the students. Immediate mastery of LMS operation is required for the students.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the hierarchy of network protocols
Be able to explain the function of network hosts and medium and its physical structure
Be able to explain the structure of IP address and Ethernet frame
Be able to explain the technical terms related to security, LAN operation and maintenance
Be able to explain the network applications such as world wide web or e-mail

It is important to understand the contents of this course because many kinds of web service, which becomes mainstream of the computer application today, are realized on the basis of the network technology.
